Where the schools of thought differ, the app tells you. We ask qualified scholars to review religious content before each release.

Awwab menunjukkan perkara yang diperselisihkan oleh mazhab. Kami meminta ulama yang berkelayakan menyemak kandungan agama sebelum setiap keluaran.

prayerUnavailable.source: The selected calculation could not find times for this location today.
prayerUnavailable.text: Kaedah yang dipilih tidak dapat mengira waktu solat untuk lokasi ini hari ini.

previewStatus.source: App preview · religious content review pending
previewStatus.text: Pratonton apl · semakan kandungan agama belum selesai

printablePrayerDescription.source: Timetable with your mosques’ jamaat times, ready for the fridge.
printablePrayerDescription.text: Jadual waktu jemaah di masjid anda, sedia untuk dicetak dan ditampal pada peti sejuk.

profileBackupHint.source: Export or restore an on-device backup
profileBackupHint.text: Eksport atau pulihkan sandaran pada peranti

profileMasjidHint.source: Built from consistency, one prayer at a time. A missed day dims the lamps.
profileMasjidHint.text: Bina masjid dengan istiqamah, satu solat pada satu masa. Lampunya malap apabila ada hari yang terlepas.

profileMinarets.source: the minarets. The masjid is nearly complete.

profileRemindersHint.source: Add prayer times to your calendar
profileRemindersHint.text: Tambah waktu solat pada takwim anda

profileShareHint.source: Make a card to save or share
profileShareHint.text: Cipta kad untuk disimpan atau dikongsi

profileWalls.source: the walls. The dome is next.

readThisAloud.text: Bolehkah anda membacanya dengan suara lantang?

readingRootSource.source: Word forms and roots · Quranic Arabic Corpus
readingRootSource.text: Bentuk dan akar kata · Quranic Arabic Corpus

recallCheck.source: Let’s see what you still remember
recallCheck.text: Mari lihat apa yang masih anda ingat

recallCheckHint.source: Most people remember more than they think. We’ll skip whatever you already know.
recallCheckHint.text: Anda mungkin ingat lebih banyak daripada yang disangka. Langkau bahagian yang sudah anda kuasai.

restoreError.source: This file could not be restored. Choose an Awwab backup.
restoreError.text: Fail ini tidak dapat dipulihkan. Pilih fail sandaran Awwab.

returnsExplanation.source: Times you came back after a gap
returnsExplanation.text: Bilangan kali anda kembali selepas terhenti

saveError.source: Your changes could not be saved. Try again.
saveError.text: Perubahan anda tidak dapat disimpan. Cuba lagi.

settingsAboutDetails.source: Awwab is an offline companion for returning to prayer and relearning Quranic Arabic.
settingsAboutDetails.text: Awwab boleh digunakan di luar talian untuk membantu anda kembali menjaga solat dan belajar semula bahasa Arab al-Quran.

settingsCalendarEstimate.source: Estimated Hijri date. Check your local moon-sighting announcement.
settingsCalendarEstimate.text: Tarikh Hijrah anggaran. Semak pengumuman cerapan anak bulan di tempat anda.

settingsCalendarSaved.source: Calendar file prepared. Open it in your calendar to add the reminders.
settingsCalendarSaved.text: Fail kalendar sudah tersedia. Bukanya dalam kalendar anda untuk menambah peringatan.

settingsDataExportError.source: The backup could not be exported. Try again.
settingsDataExportError.text: Sandaran tidak dapat dieksport. Cuba lagi.

settingsDataNote.source: Prayer logs, learning progress and settings are stored on this device.
settingsDataNote.text: Rekod solat, kemajuan pembelajaran dan tetapan disimpan pada peranti ini.

settingsDataRestoreError.source: That file could not be restored. Choose a valid Awwab backup.
settingsDataRestoreError.text: Fail itu tidak dapat dipulihkan. Pilih fail sandaran Awwab yang sah.

settingsDataRestoreNote.source: Restoring replaces the records on this device with the records in the file.
settingsDataRestoreNote.text: Apabila dipulihkan, semua rekod pada peranti ini akan digantikan dengan rekod daripada fail sandaran.

settingsDeskCaption.source: Everything is stored on this device · back it up as a file
settingsDeskCaption.text: Semua data disimpan pada peranti ini · simpan salinannya sebagai fail

settingsHijriNote.source: The adjustment applies to Umm al-Qura estimates until a confirmed month start supplies an anchor.
settingsHijriNote.text: Pelarasan ini digunakan pada tarikh anggaran Umm al-Qura sehingga awal bulan disahkan dan dijadikan rujukan.

settingsHijriSaved.source: Saved. Open the new calendar file to update your reminders.
settingsHijriSaved.text: Disimpan. Buka fail kalendar baharu untuk mengemas kini peringatan anda.

settingsLanguageBuiltIn.text: Terbina dalam · berfungsi di luar talian

settingsLanguageDownloadError.source: The language pack didn’t download. Try again when you’re online.
settingsLanguageDownloadError.text: Pek bahasa tidak dapat dimuat turun. Cuba lagi apabila anda dalam talian.

settingsLanguageGuide.source: Read the app in your language

settingsLanguageNoResults.text: Tiada bahasa yang sepadan dengan carian.

settingsMeaningEnglish.text: Paparkan bahasa Inggeris di bawah setiap baris

settingsMeaningEnglishHint.source: Show Pickthall’s translation in Surahs and Understand your salah.
settingsMeaningEnglishHint.text: Paparkan terjemahan Pickthall dalam Surah dan Fahami solat anda.

settingsMeaningLocal.source: Quran meanings in the app language

settingsMeaningLocalEnglish.source: Pickthall’s English translation is built in.
settingsMeaningLocalEnglish.text: Terjemahan bahasa Inggeris oleh Pickthall tersedia dalam apl.

settingsMeaningLocalPending.source: A Bangla edition is pending review. Pickthall’s English translation is available.
settingsMeaningLocalPending.text: Edisi bahasa Bangla masih menunggu semakan. Terjemahan bahasa Inggeris oleh Pickthall tersedia.

settingsMeaningOtherPending.source: A local edition is pending review. Pickthall’s English translation is available.
settingsMeaningOtherPending.text: Edisi bahasa setempat masih menunggu semakan. Terjemahan bahasa Inggeris oleh Pickthall tersedia.

settingsNastaliqDownloadHint.source: Download {size} on first use for long Urdu guidance.
settingsNastaliqDownloadHint.text: Muat turun {size} pada penggunaan pertama untuk panduan panjang dalam bahasa Urdu.

settingsNastaliqError.source: Awwab could not change the Urdu reading style.
settingsNastaliqError.text: Awwab tidak dapat menukar gaya bacaan Urdu.

settingsNastaliqHint.source: Use Nastaliq with more line spacing in long Urdu guidance.
settingsNastaliqHint.text: Gunakan tulisan Nastaliq dengan jarak baris lebih luas dalam panduan panjang bahasa Urdu.

settingsPrayerLocal.source: Times use the selected city and stay on your device. Local mosque timetables can differ.
settingsPrayerLocal.text: Waktu dikira mengikut bandar yang dipilih dan disimpan pada peranti anda. Jadual masjid setempat mungkin berbeza.

settingsPrivacyDetails.source: Prayer logs, learning progress, and settings are stored on this device. Awwab has no accounts or analytics.
settingsPrivacyDetails.text: Rekod solat, kemajuan pembelajaran dan tetapan disimpan pada peranti ini. Awwab tiada akaun atau analitik.

settingsPrivacyLocation.source: Location is optional. Prayer times are calculated on your device using the city or coordinates you choose.
settingsPrivacyLocation.text: Lokasi digunakan dengan izin anda. Waktu solat dikira pada peranti mengikut bandar atau koordinat yang anda pilih.

settingsSuggestionHint.source: Press and hold text on a touchscreen or open the suggestion form. Suggestions stay on your device and can be exported as a file.
settingsSuggestionHint.text: Tekan lama pada teks di skrin sentuh atau buka borang cadangan. Cadangan kekal pada peranti anda dan boleh dieksport sebagai fail.

settingsTextSample.source: Take a moment. Read at your own pace.
settingsTextSample.text: Ambil masa sejenak. Baca mengikut rentak anda.

settingsTimeZoneError.source: Enter a time zone such as Asia/Dhaka or Europe/London.
settingsTimeZoneError.text: Masukkan zon waktu seperti Asia/Dhaka atau Europe/London.

settingsYourWordsHint.source: Muslims say these differently. Pick what sounds right to you.
settingsYourWordsHint.text: Umat Islam menggunakan istilah yang berbeza. Pilih istilah yang biasa anda gunakan.

settingsYourWordsSub.source: How Muslims around you say it
settingsYourWordsSub.text: Istilah yang digunakan oleh masyarakat Islam di tempat anda

setupAnswerHint-easy.source: I can read this on my own

setupAudioExcerpt.text: Petikan ayat yang dipendekkan dan dikodkan semula

setupAyahHint.source: This is the second āyah of Al-ʿAsr. Try reading it all the way through.
setupAyahHint.text: Ini ayat kedua surah Al-ʿAsr. Cuba baca hingga habis.

setupChangeLanguage.source: You can change the language in Settings at any time.
setupChangeLanguage.text: Anda boleh menukar bahasa dalam Tetapan pada bila-bila masa.

setupDevice.source: No account. Everything stays on this device and works offline.
setupDevice.text: Tiada akaun diperlukan. Semua data kekal pada peranti ini dan apl boleh digunakan di luar talian.

setupEightQuestions.source: Eight quick questions help find a starting lesson. Choose what feels right to you.
setupEightQuestions.text: Lapan soalan ringkas membantu mencari pelajaran permulaan. Pilih jawapan yang paling sesuai dengan anda.

setupFeature-maktab-2.text: Ejaan gaya Ampara dipilih secara lalai

setupHarakatHint.source: Look at the little mark below the letter. It adds an i sound.
setupHarakatHint.text: Lihat tanda kecil di bawah huruf. Tanda itu menghasilkan bunyi “i”.

setupHowLearn.source: How would you like to learn?

setupLetterHint.source: Take a moment with the letter. Tap it to see the name, sound and how it joins.
setupLetterHint.text: Perhatikan huruf ini. Ketik untuk melihat nama, bunyi dan cara ia bersambung.

setupMode-adult.source: Calm and meaning-first. Explanations, sources and word anatomy front and centre.
setupMode-adult.text: Belajar dengan tenang dan utamakan makna, dengan penerangan, sumber dan anatomi kata.

setupMode-maktab.source: Learn like you did at 12, with brighter colours, shorter lessons, stars and stickers.
setupMode-maktab.text: Belajar semula seperti waktu kecil, dengan warna ceria, pelajaran pendek, bintang dan pelekat.

setupPlaybackError.source: This recording could not play. You can try again or continue with the text.
setupPlaybackError.text: Rakaman ini tidak dapat dimainkan. Cuba lagi atau teruskan dengan teks.

setupSaveError.source: Awwab could not save your choices. Try again.
setupSaveError.text: Awwab tidak dapat menyimpan pilihan anda. Cuba lagi.

setupWordsHint.source: These words open Al-Ikhlāṣ. Try them one at a time.
setupWordsHint.text: Ini kata-kata pembuka surah Al-Ikhlāṣ. Cuba baca satu demi satu.

sourcesAdhan.source: Prayer times are computed on this device with Adhan, MIT.
sourcesAdhan.text: Waktu solat dikira pada peranti ini menggunakan Adhan, berlesen MIT.

sourcesCorpus.source: Version 0.4 morphology, © 2011 Kais Dukes, GNU GPL. Awwab includes the original morphology file and derives its 125 core words and Fātiḥa lemma index from it.
sourcesCorpus.text: Morfologi versi 0.4, © 2011 Kais Dukes, GNU GPL. Awwab menyertakan fail morfologi asal dan menggunakannya untuk mengenal pasti 125 kata asas serta membina indeks lema Al-Fātiḥah.

sourcesDigitalKhatt.source: IndoPak 15-line Quran text (MIT), IndoPak and Madina fonts (SIL Open Font License). © Amine Anane and Tarteel Inc.
sourcesDigitalKhatt.text: Teks al-Quran IndoPak 15 baris (MIT), fon IndoPak dan Madina (SIL Open Font License). © Amine Anane dan Tarteel Inc.

sourcesExcerptCredit.source: Meaning of the excerpt by Awwab

sourcesFonts.source: The Noto, Baloo 2 and Nunito fonts use the SIL Open Font License. The local notices credit the Noto families used for language names and downloaded translations.
sourcesFonts.text: Fon Noto, Baloo 2 dan Nunito menggunakan SIL Open Font License. Notis lesen setempat menyatakan keluarga fon Noto yang digunakan untuk nama bahasa dan terjemahan yang dimuat turun.

sourcesHadith.source: Distributed as public-domain data under the Unlicense. Individual narrations show their specific collection, reference and grade.
sourcesHadith.text: Data domain awam diedarkan di bawah Unlicense. Setiap riwayat memaparkan nama himpunan, rujukan dan tarafnya.

sourcesMaps.source: Haram points come from OpenStreetMap. The Makkah and Madinah map packs are Protomaps extracts. © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License.
sourcesMaps.text: Lokasi di Tanah Haram bersumberkan OpenStreetMap. Pek peta Makkah dan Madinah ialah petikan daripada Protomaps. © Penyumbang OpenStreetMap, Open Database License.

sourcesPickthall.source: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran. English renderings from Tanzil’s translation archive.
sourcesPickthall.text: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran. Terjemahan bahasa Inggeris daripada arkib terjemahan Tanzil.

sourcesQaidaSpeech.source: Generated pronunciation for Qaida drills and the placement sounds.
sourcesQaidaSpeech.text: Sebutan janaan untuk latihan Qaida dan bunyi dalam ujian penempatan.

sourcesStudyAid.source: Awwab is a learning and tracking aid. Ask a qualified scholar about religious rulings for your situation.
sourcesStudyAid.text: Awwab membantu anda belajar dan menyimpan rekod. Rujuk ulama yang berkelayakan untuk hukum agama yang berkaitan dengan keadaan anda.

sourcesTanzil.source: Uthmani Quran text, © Tanzil Project, CC BY 3.0. The distributed verses are preserved verbatim.
sourcesTanzil.text: Teks al-Quran Uthmani, © Projek Tanzil, CC BY 3.0. Ayat yang diedarkan dikekalkan tanpa perubahan.

studyQaida14.text: Syaddah dengan mad dan syaddah berturutan

todayQaidaDetail.source: Reading · {minutes, number} min · picks up where you left
todayQaidaDetail.text: Bacaan · {minutes, number} min · sambung dari bahagian terakhir

welcomeHeading.source: For those who keep coming back.

welcomeMeaning.source: “…He is ever forgiving to those who keep returning.”
welcomeMeaning.text: “…Sesungguhnya Dia sentiasa mengampuni orang yang kembali kepada-Nya.”

welcomeOffline.source: No judgement. No accounts. Works fully offline, and everything stays on your phone.
welcomeOffline.text: Mulakan semula mengikut kemampuan. Tiada akaun diperlukan. Awwab berfungsi di luar talian dan data kekal pada telefon anda.
